artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: NEW. THE MODEL-BLOCK SCOPE CONTRACT -- the one declaration of what a figure's `scope` may be, for every reader of a landed model_block.json. Declares SCOPE_HEADER and SCOPE_FISCAL_YEAR_LINE_ITEM plus MODEL_BLOCK_SCOPES, and `unknown_scopes(figures)` which answers by SUBTRACTION over the observed set (Rule 24(i)) rather than by a forward list. PLACED IN checkface/ AND NOT IN THE API ADAPTER because the check face and the read adapter are two consumers of the same artifact -- a constant in either would be the other's literal. THE CONTRACT IS THE PRODUCER'S: the vocabulary is transcribed from integrations/bloomberg/research/model_block_pull.py:392/400/421/426, the only thing that writes the field, and the transcription is NOT trusted on its word -- a test parses that producer's source and asserts set equality. A DELIBERATE NON-ADDITION is documented in the file: no second `figures_in_scope()` matcher that raises on an undeclared scope, because two matchers over one artifact reintroduces this very defect one layer up, and because returning [] for a scope nobody writes is CORRECT -- the defect was that nobody compared the QUESTION against the contract, which is a test-time property.

THE REPAIR ITSELF, three lines. read_thesis_bundle asked `_figures(model_block, "fiscal_year")` (:499) against an artifact whose rows carry `fiscal_year_line_item` -- zero matches, 13 headers and ZERO fiscal figures and ZERO checks returned for 183 real rows, and nothing failed because an empty list is a perfectly good list. All three call sites (:485 in read_security_overlay, :498 and :499 in read_thesis_bundle) now take their scope from the contract. MEASURED AFTERWARDS: the module holds NO scope literal of its own -- `comp-read lib/research/api/scoped_amgt.py --enumerate 'fiscal_year"|"header"|fiscal_year_line_item'` returns 0 hit(s) across 743 lines / 41 sections. `_figures` itself is UNCHANGED and remains the tolerant equality filter, deliberately: AC3's negative control calls it with a bogus scope and requires a COUNT of 0, so making it raise would break the order's own control.

NEW, 9 tests. Asserts the fiscal count is 183 and not zero (the criterion this cell was cut for), pins the 196 denominator first, pins HEADER at 13, and asserts 196 figures in -> 196 check rows out. TIES THE CONTRACT TO BOTH ENDS rather than restating it a third time: to the PRODUCER by parsing model_block_pull.py for the `"scope": "..."` values it emits and asserting set equality in both directions with the two difference sets named; and to the LANDED ARTIFACT by subtraction over the real block. Carries the NON-VACUOUS negative control AC3 was meant to be -- bogus scope 0 AND the historically wrong 'fiscal_year' still 0, both against a real 196-figure block. Refuses a vacuous parse (a producer scan returning the empty set fails loudly rather than passing against anything), and refuses a fixture fallback if the artifact cannot be read.
